title: Reconcile open PRs every 5 minutes instead of 15
goal: The auto-merge reconciler (scripts/reconcile-prs.sh via auto-merge.yml's schedule trigger) is a fallback-only safety net for merges the event-driven path misses (a dropped workflow_run, a green run that finished before the PR opened, a transient merge refusal); it is lightweight (gh api polling only, no builds). Tighten its worst-case recovery window from 15 to 5 minutes.
